seo.title: Watch Green Bay Packers & Oregon Ducks in Mission Beach | Miss B's Coconut Club
seo.description: Miss B's Coconut Club is Mission Beach's official watch party bar for Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks fans. Outdoor screens, game day specials, and cold drinks at 3704 Mission Blvd, San Diego.

body: Miss B's Coconut Club is Mission Beach's official watch party headquarters for Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks fans. Catch every game on our outdoor screens just steps from the Pacific on Mission Blvd.
Game day specials, tropical cocktails, cold beer, and the open-air vibe that makes every kickoff feel like a celebration. Walk-ins welcome — reservations recommended for big games.

Every Game,

feature.body: We show every Green Bay Packers and Oregon Ducks game — regular season, playoffs, and championship runs. Come early, grab your spot, and celebrate every play with the Mission Beach crowd.
